items.title: Microsoft Teams to Prompt Mobile Users for Browser Choice with Non-Office and PDF Links
items.description: Microsoft is rolling out a significant update to Teams Mobile on Android and iOS that changes how non-Office and PDF links are handled within the app. Beginning in late February 2026, users will be presented with a browser selection prompt when tapping links to files that aren’t Office documents (Word, Excel, or PowerPoint) or PDFs. items.description: Survey underscores the reality that scammers follow "scalable opportunities and low friction," rather than rich targets that tend to be better protected.

items.title: OpenAI Launches EVMbench to Detect, Patch, and Exploit Vulnerabilities in Blockchain Environments
